chaining: Per-record unlimited: 5 MiB per file across unlimited files, blocks, and free workspaces. Sharding large datasets into 5 MiB objects requires approximately 200,000 objects per terabyte at the 600 requests per minute API rate limit.
limits_note: 5 MiB per file on Free (hard, enforced by API); 20 MiB per single-part API upload; parts must be 5-20 MiB; 600 requests/min per workspace (avg 10/s) shared across all connections; only whitelisted MIME types (audio/document/image/video/CAD) - arbitrary binary is rejected

identity_cost.detail: Sign up with your work email

reliability_note: The MIME whitelist is the killer: no generic octet-stream blobs, so archival datasets must be packed as .zip/.7z/.tar which Notion does accept. Signed URLs expire in one hour, so serving 1 TB/day out of Notion means re-minting continuously.

extras.verified_at_basis: checked against the live service on 2026-11-10
extras.quota_verbatim: No total storage cap: 'Unlimited file uploads' on Free, but each file is capped at 5 MiB on Free (5 GiB on paid). Block limit is unlimited for a single-member Free workspace.
extras.limits_verbatim: 5 MiB per file on Free (hard, enforced by API); 20 MiB per single-part API upload; parts must be 5-20 MiB; 600 requests/min per workspace (avg 10/s) shared across all connections; only whitelisted MIME types (audio/document/image/video/CAD) - arbitrary binary is rejected
extras.egress_verbatim: Free; Notion serves via S3/presigned URLs on Cloudflare-fronted notion.com. File objects return 'An authenticated HTTP GET URL... valid for one hour', so links must be re-minted - no CDN you can pin a cache to without re-signing.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Per-record unlimited: 5 MiB x unlimited files x unlimited blocks x unlimited free workspaces. A 20 TiB archive sharded into 5 MiB objects = ~4.2M objects - feasible at 600 req/min but ~5 days of continuous upload. This is the clearest 'unlimited count, tiny per-file cap' in the niche.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Official Notion API file-upload endpoints (single-part <=20 MiB, multi-part above with 5-20 MiB parts) + PlakarKorp/integration-notion and many notion-backup repos for bulk extraction; no rclone backend
extras.agent_focus: Team collaboration suites: Slack free (files, retention), Microsoft Teams, Mattermost, Rocket.Chat, Zulip, Twist, Discourse, Basecamp, ClickUp, Notion, Coda, Airtable attachments

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
